meta.title: Leonida Atlas — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Tracker
meta.hours_note: About 200 hours per PowerPyx and GTABase; Push Square puts it at 250+ hours.
meta.method: Read 20 Nov 2026. Every guide below was written from the seven sources listed in the Source Matrix, cross-checked trophy by trophy. A method stated by two or more sources is marked confirmed; a method only one source gives is single-source; a method no source confirms is unconfirmed. Where sources disagree, the trophy carries a disagree flag naming the conflict. No text was copied from any source: every step is written fresh from the facts. Per-trophy Gamerscore values are deliberately not printed — the sources' values disagree with each other (for example the final-mission gold is 50G in GTABase and OutputLag but 100G in Of Zen and Computing). PSN points use the standard scale: bronze 15, silver 30, gold 90, platinum 180.

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.depth: Deepest single source: step-level methods, counts and the 3-step roadmap for all 55 trophies.

sources.name: GTABase
sources.depth: Full list with Gamerscore, hidden flags and per-trophy unlock tips; 100% checklist figures.

sources.name: OutputLag
sources.page: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.depth: Strong on robberies, partner trophies, the missable warning and the no-mission-replay save rules.

sources.name: SixShore
sources.page: GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: All 55, Missables and Roadmap
sources.depth: Best for disagreements: Push Square vs PowerPyx on time, hidden count and missables.

sources.name: GTA Zone
sources.page: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.depth: Clean per-trophy unlock lines and roadmap; carries GTABase's cheat-session note.

sources.name: FullSweep
sources.page: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements (wiki)
sources.depth: Flags the two differently-worded trophies and the five unconfirmed requirements.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing
sources.depth: Full list with a 9-step roadmap; its flat Gamerscore values and story-trophy claims conflict with the others.

stages.title: First Steps in Leonida
stages.text: Play the story and let the early trophies come to you. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the morning it is offered, scan every new vehicle with WAiNK, study animals through the binoculars, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay.

stages.title: Vice City Rising
stages.text: Finish the story: the remaining chapter and mission trophies all pop on the way, and the final mission lands the gold. Partner play unlocks in Chapter 2, so duo trophies open up from here. Keep an untouched save from just before the final mission.

stages.title: Side Strands & Character Finales
stages.span: Free roam, any chapter after unlock
stages.text: Close out the six character questlines — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — and finish eight qualifying stranger strands. None of this is needed for 100%, and every strand stays open after the story.

stages.title: Crime Wave
stages.text: Work the robbery chain in unlock order: Snap Gun in Chapter 3, Key Cloner in Chapter 3, bank vaults in Chapter 4. Bring your partner for the duo trophies, and let the vault jobs hand you the 4-star escape. Two of the hidden one-offs live here too.

stages.title: Activities, Races & Collectibles
stages.text: The big open-world grind: stunts, races, drone races, shooting ranges, cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles, map fog, garages and spending. Do the fun half now and leave the tail for the checklist stage, where most of it counts double.

stages.title: The Long Road
stages.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist line by line. It is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — and most of it is already done from the earlier stages. A Long Road is the hardest trophy and the last real gate.

stages.title: Leonida Legend
stages.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the last trophy lands — for most players that is A Long Road. One playthrough, no online trophies, no DLC: the platinum is the finish line, not a separate hunt.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Nothing needs multiplayer, DLC or a second playthrough; A Long Road is the last gate for most players.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops automatically once the last one lands.
Nothing needs multiplayer, DLC or a second playthrough — the whole list is single-player.
A Long Road is the last gate for most players, so plan the run around the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It lands a little late, after the first mission of Chapter 2.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 1.
It lands a little late — after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 opens, after Welcome to Vice City.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2.
It pops as Chapter 3 opens, after Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3.
It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It pops on the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 4.
It pops on the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.disagree_note: Of Zen and Computing words this as 'Complete Chapter 5' and values it at 100G; GTABase, OutputLag and GTA Zone say the final mission at 50G. The official description says the final mission.
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the final mission. Free roam continues after the credits, so all cleanup can wait until after this pops.

steps.t: Play through to the final mission and finish the story.
Free roam continues after the credits, so cleanup can wait until after this pops.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission. It pops during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.t: Play Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission.
Story trophy — it pops during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. It pops when the heist ends.

steps.t: Play The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission.
The trophy pops when the heist ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.disagree_note: PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient, close to 60% true completion; Push Square (via SixShore) says you need almost everything, including 15 of the 18 card sets. The full-requirement lines below are the ones both sides agree on.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story. Work done during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable.

steps.t: Finish the story first: the checklist only appears afterwards, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work done during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
Clear the full-requirement lines first: all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every shooting-range gold, all drone races, Bret's 15 target decks.
Then hit the partial lines: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts.
The list is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — so most of it pops while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds. Under-bridge flights are the quickest; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up.
Keep going to 300 — the 100% checklist needs 300.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Most come naturally during the story; check Progress > Activities for what is left.

steps.t: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, a race win, and a stunt.
Check what is left under Progress > Activities; most come naturally during the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges. Ranges also raise Focus, which helps Gunslinger later.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges.
Ranges also raise Focus, which makes Gunslinger easier later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 races.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so finish each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 on offer. Repeating a win does not count — each race must be a new one.

steps.t: Win 20 different races from the 40 on offer.
Repeating a win does not count — each race must be a new one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, follow his fishing quests, and beat him in his fishing challenge.

steps.t: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Wait for his text, then follow the purple fishing marker and play through his fishing quests.
Beat him in his fishing challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one of the 4 in-game video games through to the end. Three run on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade cabinets.

steps.t: Pick any of the 4 in-game video games and play it to the end: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three run on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
You only need to reach the end once — no challenge runs required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only strand: Andy calls in Chapter 3, then texts an address in Belville. Play all five quests in order; the trophy pops on the last.

steps.t: Wait for Andy's call during Chapter 3 while playing as Lucia; she texts an address in Belville.
Play all five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops on the last one; the strand stays open after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving strand: recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so it is not missable.

steps.t: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 (green KR icon, Key Lento) and take his treasure-diving work.
Dive the purple chest markers at 7 shipwrecks and dig up the treasure with the metal detector.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later — finish it then; it is not missable.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Play his five jobs; the trophy pops on Hometown Heroes.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Play Billy's five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.
The trophy pops on Hometown Heroes; all five stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; several character questlines do not. Check the trophy's counter after each strand.

steps.t: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count, so do not waste time on them for this.
Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand — the remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed.
None of this is needed for 100%, and every strand stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list: deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City. The Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 story mission opens the high-end cars.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, Randy hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars.
The Key Cloner from that mission lets you break into high-end cars.
Scan cars with WAiNK to check them against the list, then deliver each one to Randy's garage in west Vice City.
Deliver in good condition for better pay; the list stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only strand: after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, clear the Synthetic Labs in Vice City, then take Tyrone's Spin On This quest.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — Jason only.
Clear the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest.
Tyrone then offers Spin On This; shutting the labs down pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.disagree_note: PowerPyx, GTABase and OutputLag flag this as possibly missable; Push Square (via SixShore) lists no known missables, and Of Zen and Computing says the community thinks nothing is missable. Nobody has confirmed whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required — do it anyway.
trophies.guide: THE missable watch: meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, including the Chapter 1 balcony meditation that vanishes after the chapter. Each spot counts twice if both characters meditate there.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Then meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations — each spot counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there.
The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops: it is unconfirmed whether the balcony meditation is required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only hunting strand with Bret Vogel. The exact animal that triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed — clearing all 15 target decks should cover it.

steps.t: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Bret Vogel texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County — Jason only.
Take his hunting quests and bring the animals back to him; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
Clear all 15 target decks — the 100% checklist needs them anyway, and they should cover the unique-animal trigger.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. You do not need all 18 for the trophy.

steps.t: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets.
Card locations are tracked in the collectible guides; you do not need all 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100 to find.

steps.t: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count.
There are more than 100 to find (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures), so pick the easy ones.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — save the hardest 10 for last.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges, listed under Progress > Challenges.
The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — save the hardest 10 for last.
Most complete on their own while you play; check the completed mark when scrolling.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, build a 4-star wanted level and escape past the red heat zone. Bank vault jobs hand you 4 stars automatically.

steps.t: Unlock partner play after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, then call your partner in.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape until you leave the red heat zone — leaving the flashing search area is not enough.
Bank vault jobs hand you 4 stars automatically, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob 3 shops back-to-back while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade, the chain breaks.

steps.t: With your partner along, rob 3 shops back-to-back while the police are still chasing you.
If the stars fade to just the red heat zone, the chain breaks — keep the flashing wanted level alive.
The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it does not land.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning them with WAiNK counts; you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning them with WAiNK counts; you do not need to drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; 557 vehicles exist at launch.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus window. Buff focus first, use an assault rifle, and pick gang enemies — soldiers, police and civilians seem not to count.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) near a group of gang enemies.
Eat, drink or use Adrenaline first to extend the focus window, and use an assault rifle.
Drop 5 enemies in the one window — gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to.
Higher Focus levels (raised at shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing) make it much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.disagree_note: FullSweep notes the two main guides word this trophy's condition differently; PowerPyx and OutputLag agree on the docked-plane method below, so the guide follows them.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — gates E3/E4 work — and fly about 1 km away before it pops.

steps.t: At VCIA, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3/E4 work; planes parked on the airfield do not.
Enter via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km from the airport before the trophy pops; save first, the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west of the map, and drive and fire until it pops.

steps.t: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west of the map.
Tanks are parked on the south side of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Get in, drive and fire until the trophy pops; save first.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 gives you the Snap Gun, slip in a store's back door, loot the safe, kill the footage and alarm, and leave unseen.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun and unlock jewelry robberies.
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm.
Inside, find the safe-code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave unseen.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each 4-star heat. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4; 100% needs all 8.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vault robberies.
Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
Rob any 5 of the 8 vaults and escape each 4-star heat; 100% needs all 8.
Pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more vans once his earlier quests are done.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. A bank vault job counts, or blow a truck's back door open with a sticky bomb from Chapter 3.

steps.t: Rob a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) — the vault job counts as an armored truck robbery.
Or, earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. Flying a plane over every fogged area is far faster than driving.

steps.t: Unfog the whole map of Leonida.
Fly a plane over every fogged area — it is far faster than driving.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total.
Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them; track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.
The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Single-source method: at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar. Other guides still list this one as unconfirmed.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Single-source method: with the Key Cloner from Chapter 3, hack the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window. Other guides still list this one as unconfirmed.

steps.t: Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and hack the blue Banshee.
Drive it forward straight through the showroom window — only this car counts.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.disagree_note: FullSweep says the guides word this trophy differently and the exact task is not confirmed; PowerPyx and OutputLag agree on the three-valuables method below, so the guide follows them.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then escape the police. The operation respawns later, so it is not missable.

steps.t: Bring Sticky Bombs, then hit Kingpin Bowling, the gang operation in Port Gellhorn (marked in Chapter 2).
Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east corner, and the office safe (blow it with a Sticky Bomb).
Escape the police — the trophy pops on the escape, not on the third item.
Left something behind? The operation respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.disagree_note: Of Zen and Computing calls this a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign; PowerPyx and OutputLag say it needs maximum Strength on both characters at once. The guide follows the two detailed sources.
trophies.guide: Raise Strength to maximum on BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train with your partner along — the partner trains alongside you.

steps.t: Raise Strength to maximum on BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time.
Buy a gym membership and always train with your partner along — the partner trains alongside you.
Check levels under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.disagree_note: Of Zen and Computing calls this a story trophy tied to a campaign choice; PowerPyx and GTABase say it needs 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The guide follows the two detailed sources.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it passively, so it usually fills up on its own.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies and fights feed it passively.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to see what counts.
Check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent and makes police more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no source has a verified unlock method yet. PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — keep a save before Payday Loans jobs.

steps.t: No confirmed unlock method exists yet — PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Keep a manual save before Payday Loans jobs and replay them if the trophy stays locked.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Single-source method: the UFO easter egg north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, solo. Other guides still list this one as unconfirmed.

steps.t: At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and return; the spawn is random.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, then talk to the woman it drops and help her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no source has a verified unlock method yet. PowerPyx believes it comes from kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle.

steps.t: No confirmed unlock method exists yet — PowerPyx believes it comes from kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle.
Try melee attacks from a moving bike until a confirmed method is published.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. The total is cumulative across robberies; bank vaults can pay up to $205,000 in one job.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 total is cumulative across robberies; bank vaults can pay up to $205,000 in one job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route — they are the most expensive items.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app — about $160,000 total. The 4 story garages do not count.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages — about $160,000 total; the 4 story garages do not count.
Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Buy garage space first, then take stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Moses, the Scooter Bros app is installed.
Buy garage space first — each car needs a free spot.
Take a stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register; repeat for 10 vehicles.
From Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at Pay 'n' Spray.
